name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.4.5
summary: SYSVOL replication mass-delete brake usability: reviewable pending sets, operator approval/rejection workflows, configurable thresholds, and real user audit logging
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.4.5:
* **Configurable Mass-Deletion Safety Brake:** Threshold adjusted to trip only when numToDelete > 50 or (numToDelete > 10 and numToDelete > 20% of totalFiles), configurable via `sysvol_partners.json` settings (`mass_delete_min_files`, `mass_delete_pct`, `mass_delete_max_files`).
* **Reviewable Pending Set & Approval Flow:** Pending mass deletion set recorded with partner IP, exact paths, and detected_at timestamp (`GET /api/v1/sysvol/mass-delete/pending`). Fulladmin approval (`POST /api/v1/sysvol/mass-delete/confirm`) verifies timestamp and candidate subset before execution. Immediate re-trip if unapproved files appear.
* **Rejection & Self-Healing Restoration:** Operator rejection (`POST /api/v1/sysvol/mass-delete/reject`) drops pending list, clears tombstones, and protects local files by updating mtime to push back to partner.
* **Real User Audit Logging:** Strict attribution to authenticated `user['username']` on all Sysvol replication operations.
* **Interactive Admin UI:** New review modal with full path inspection, approval, and rejection controls.
